summary: Iter87 — Verified new 'bon via chat' feature (admin sends today's receipt as a chat card) + chat-icon visibility rules. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kiosk_chat_receipt_ws.py: 4/4 PASS covering (1) admin WS {type:chat_send, emp_key, receipt_payment_id, text:''} → employee + admin both receive chat with message.receipt={payment_id, receipt_number, amount, currency, tenant_name, paid_at}, text is empty; chat_threads shows last_text='Bon verstuurd' for receipt-only messages (via Mongo aggregation $cond). (2) Admin sends with text + invalid receipt_payment_id → text is still sent, message.receipt is null. (3) Empty text + invalid pid → nothing is sent to either side. (4) Empty text + no pid → nothing is sent. Frontend Playwright (admin kiosk context, 1920x1080): kiosk-chat-btn is visible on step='select' (location picker) with svg class containing 'text-white' (icon is WHITE as required) ✓; kiosk-presence-dot visible on home ✓; clicking kiosk-chat-btn opens kiosk-chat-panel ✓; opening a thread → kiosk-chat-send-receipt button present ✓; clicking it opens kiosk-chat-receipt-picker ✓; today's test payment appears as kiosk-chat-receipt-pick-{paymentId} ✓; picking it inserts kiosk-chat-receipt-{paymentId} card in the conversation ✓; tapping the card opens kiosk-chat-receipt-viewer with Afdruk (kiosk-chat-receipt-print), KT-V520 button (via KtpPrintButton on non-apk desktop), and kiosk-chat-receipt-close ✓. Visibility: after clicking a location+apartment (step='overview'), both kiosk-chat-btn and kiosk-presence-dot are hidden (offsetWidth=0) ✓, matching the onHome={step==='select'} prop. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: _chat_receipt (backend/server.py:10486) resolves tenant_name only via tenants collection (lookup by tenant_id). It ignores payment.tenant_name (denormalized), so for payments without tenant_id — e.g. walk-in cash receipts or legacy records — the receipt card always shows the fallback 'Huurder'. Consider: tenant_name = (t or {}).get('name') or p.get('tenant_name') or 'Huurder'.

ChatReceiptPicker (KioskChatReceipt.jsx) always fetches /kiosk/print-log with since=todayStartIso() — fine, but the picker lives inside the Conversation (opened per thread) and refetches every time the admin opens the picker, even for the same thread in the same session. A small cache or SWR would avoid flicker on repeated opens.

ChatReceiptViewer renders the bon preview iframe at a fixed w-[240px] inside a flex-1 min-h-0 container. On narrow phones (<300px) the iframe gets clipped on the sides; consider w-full max-w-[280px] with mx-auto.

Kiosk 'Nieuw bericht (n)' pill (kiosk-chat-new-pill) is only shown when !visible AND unread > 0 AND !chat.open. Good. But because installKioskChat() is invoked inside <KioskChat>, when visible=false the whole chat subtree still mounts (correct) — just confirming the pill still works because KioskChat itself is rendered unconditionally (only its inner <button> is wrapped in {visible && ...}).

Admin picker lists ALL employees' receipts of today (as requested). The onclick path calls sendChat('', receiptFromLog(l)) which sets text='' and receipt object. The server then re-resolves receipt from the payment_id to ensure data integrity — good defense in depth. receiptFromLog's client-side tenant_name uses l.payment.tenant_name (denormalized), while server uses tenants.name — these can differ. Minor consistency concern.
